name: Evelyn Regner - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council directive on Business in Europe: Framework for Income Taxation (BEFIT)
part_text:
The European Parliament wants a common set of rules for how large cross-border companies work out their taxable profits across the EU, instead of 27 different national systems. It proposes amendments to the Commission's draft law: a single combined tax base for a group, then a share for each country. It also asks for minimum penalties for late or false reporting, extra tax on certain royalty payments, and a permanent way to divide profits between countries after 2035.

- **What changes:** One shared way to calculate company profits, with a share for each EU country; new rules on royalties, foreign subsidiaries and penalties.
- **Who it affects:** Large company groups with yearly revenue of 750 million euros or more; smaller groups can opt in.
- **What happens next:** Parliament has given its opinion; EU governments must now decide, and they can change the text.
